subject: PyStan segmentation fault 11 while fitting ODE system

messages.author: bacb0402e67daa77
messages.subject: PyStan segmentation fault 11 while fitting ODE system
parts:
Hi All,

So for the ODE soil carbon I'm working with, I need to spin the model up to equilibrium before adding soil temperature forcing to the system. I do this with an if loop:

if (x >= x_r[5]) {
  st <- a0 + a1 * cos(y * w) + b1 * sin(y * w) + a2 * cos(2 * y * w) + b2 * sin(2 * y * w) + a3 * cos(3 * y * w) + b3 * sin(3 * y * w);
  return st;
  }
else
  return 280.;
}

where x_r[5] is the spin up time.

With a spin up time of 0, the MCMC at least runs okay (not sure if the solutions are fitting data or look alright, but I'll check that later). However, if I put in a non-zero spin up time, I get a segmentation fault, no matter how many iterations I am running for. I get output like this:

Chain 0, Iteration: 3 / 10 [ 30%]  (Warmup)
Chain 0, Iteration: 4 / 10 [ 40%]  (Warmup)
Chain 0, Iteration: 5 / 10 [ 50%]  (Warmup)
Chain 0, Iteration: 6 / 10 [ 60%]  (Sampling)
Chain 0, Iteration: 7 / 10 [ 70%]  (Sampling)
Chain 0, Iteration: 8 / 10 [ 80%]  (Sampling)
Chain 0, Iteration: 9 / 10 [ 90%]  (Sampling)
Chain 0, Iteration: 10 / 10 [100%]  (Sampling)#
#  Elapsed Time: 36.6137 seconds (Warm-up)
#                35.7608 seconds (Sampling)
#                72.3745 seconds (Total)
#
>>> Segmentation fault: 11

I've attached versions of my code with both zero and non-zero spin up, and the necessary .csv data file to run the scripts.

Thanks for your help.
